title: SG-1.3 Add the PNG generation script and manifest update
summary: A deterministic script turns grid sources into PNGs in public/assets and rewrites manifest entries
description: Context: gridToRgba (frontend/src/lib/gridToRgba.ts), buildSpriteSheet (frontend/src/lib/spriteSheet.ts) and the shared PALETTE (frontend/src/lib/palette.ts) exist, but there is no PNG encoder, no grid source files, no script and no npm script. The manifest at game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json only lists SVGs. Desired behavior: a script reads grid sources, encodes PNGs with no timestamps, writes them under game/frontend/public/assets and rewrites manifest entries with path, size and frame data. Why: later cycles replace placeholder art with generated PNGs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the grid sources, when the script runs twice, then every PNG file has identical bytes
Given a generated PNG, when its IHDR is read, then width and height equal the manifest entry dimensions
Given a sheet source, when the manifest is rewritten, then the entry holds path, dimensions and frameWidth, frameHeight, frameCount
Given package.json, when scripts are read, then an art:generate npm script runs the generator

preserve: existing manifest entries not produced by a source

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
All art is raster pixel art generated in-repo from source data; no downloaded art, image services or CDN links
One shared palette of at most 48 colours; sources use palette indices only
Tests are unit tests with dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with passing unit tests
non_functional: Output is byte-identical across runs on the same Node version
